id: HL-04-own-previous-ids (0.1.2 handoff-lint, id-range with a foreign base)
note: HL-04 id-range with a foreign carry base: the ids a ledger line of the own previous file defines are carry-chain ids too. A range hiding them blocks until the draft names them alone. Ids compare without leading zeros on both sides of a range, and a range in a leading id list joined by `and` leads its line.
